'''''Pralin''''' is pulverized [[Cookbook:Praline|praline]] (caramelized [[Cookbook:Nuts and Seeds|nuts]]), which is used as a topping or addition to dessert creams, cakes, etc.

==Ingredients==
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] slivered [[Cookbook:Almond|almonds]]
* ½ cup white [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] water

== Equipment ==
* Oiled [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking sheet]] or granite work surface

==Procedure==
#Toast the almonds in a 350°F (180°C) [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] for about 10 minutes, stirring frequently until they are light brown.
# [[Cookbook:Simmering|Simmer]] the sugar and water in a small [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] until the sugar [[Cookbook:Caramel|turns golden brown]].
# Immediately sir in the almonds.
# Reheat until liquid and pour onto the baking sheet. Let cool for about 10 minutes.
# When cooled, break it into pieces.
# Pulverize in a [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]] or clean coffee grinder a few pieces at a time.
# Store in an air-tight container but use within a relatively short time period as it tends to solidify over time.
